blocks.html: The details of updating a requested item in a return.

types.name: return_id
types.description: The ID of the return to update the item in.

types.name: claim_id
types.description: The ID of the claim associated with the return, if any.

types.name: exchange_id
types.description: The ID of the exchange associated with the return, if any.

types.name: action_id
types.description:
The ID of the action associated with the item to update.
Every item has an `actions` property, whose value is an array of actions.
You can find an action with the name `RETURN_ITEM` using its `action` property,
and use the value of its `id` property.

types.name: data
types.description: The data to update in the item.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The new quantity of the item.

children.name: internal_note
children.description: An internal note viewed only by admin users.

children.name: reason_id
children.description: The ID of the reason indicating why the item is being returned.
